qualitative.gate_2_reason: Commodity price taker lacking pricing power; cyclical spot salmon prices, biological shocks, and Norwegian resource-rent taxation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Western Need, REJECT). Salmon farming pure-play is an upstream commodity price-taker whose cash flows swing with spot salmon price cycles, biological risks (string jellyfish, sea lice), and Norway's ~25-35% resource-rent aquaculture tax regime.
qualitative.evidence: Achieved record 300,900 tonnes harvest in 2025, yet Operational EBIT plunged ~28% from NOK 5.43B (2024) to NOK 3.9B (2025) as lower spot salmon prices eroded margins. Dividend was cut by 55% (NOK 22 to NOK 10). Net profits remain subject to biological shocks (jellyfish invasions) and substantial direct levies under Norway's resource-rent aquaculture tax regime.
